status: DRAFT / CANONICAL / PROSPECTIVE; historical 1.1.0/1.2.0 hashes retained in earlier manifests
canonical_status: Required controlled longitudinal family when context is applicable; supplementary families answer distinct questions and never replace Family A. Preflight failure is a fixture/methodology blocker, not a model retrieval failure.

supersedes.note: The 1.1.0 construction used frozen word-fraction insertion and remains historical under its 2026-09-19 SHA-256. 1.2.0 corrected insertion against the final rendered token stream; this prospective 1.3.0 keeps that construction geometry, word pool, facts and question block byte-identical while adding the canonical answer-oracle semantics of welp-context-0.2.0-draft (year-only item 2, echo/negation/ambiguity-safe review, coupled decoy clause).
supersedes.provenance_chain: identical constants used across qwen3-14b / qwen3.6-35b-a3b / mellum2 x2 / bonsai-2 campaigns (word pool, codes TR-8842-QX / TR-3319-WD, shipments 412/388/357)

generation_budget.rationale: The 256-token task answer budget is unchanged. A 512-token reserve is a historical operational comparator only if it represents an actual deployment cap; the semantic lane uses its bounded calibrated total ceiling as its own reserve, per welp-deployment-lanes 0.1.0-draft.

construction.filler_rule: random.Random(seed) choice over the word pool for n_words filler tokens

inserted_facts.text: The maintenance tunnel access code is TR-8842-QX.
The loading dock uses access code TR-3319-WD.

construction.insertion_mechanism: construct_family_a in harness/context.py selects filler positions iteratively against the FINAL rendered/tokenized stream, including BOS/template and fixed question tail; it must stop before inference if any depth or occupancy fails. Historical fixed word-fraction construction belongs only to the 1.1.0 snapshot.
construction.question_block:
Using only the notes above, answer all five items concisely.
1. What is the maintenance tunnel access code?
2. Which year had more Ridgeline shipments, 2027 or 2028?
3. What is the visitor center access code? If the notes do not state it, answer exactly NOT STATED.
4. How many containers did Ridgeline ship in 2029?
5. End your reply with the exact marker END-OF-REPORT and nothing after it.
construction.measurement: bounded render/apply-template plus tokenize on the FINAL stream with identical special-token behavior to inference; fact token starts uniquely located in the final stream, all five depths and occupancy independently verified before inference; no model generation during preflight

gates.exact_retrieval: item-1 answer contains TR-8842-QX and the produced answer never contains the decoy TR-3319-WD (historical clause kept: deliberately coupled to decoy_resistance, not an independent task)
gates.synthesis: item-2 answer names 2027 as the year with more Ridgeline shipments; the question asks only which year, so the counts 412/388 are never demanded
gates.decoy_resistance: the produced answer never contains TR-3319-WD
gates.absent_information: item-3 answer is the marker NOT STATED for the visitor center code
gates.retrieval_95: item-4 answer contains the standalone count 357 for the 95%-depth fact
gates.instruction_compliance: the produced answer ends with the exact marker END-OF-REPORT and nothing after it

canonical_accepted_answers: Maintenance tunnel access code is TR-8842-QX. 2027 had more Ridgeline shipments than 2028. NOT STATED. 357. END-OF-REPORT
answer_oracle.rejection: prompt echoes (frozen question-block sentences never score), negated or hedged year, code or count claims, quoted code or count mentions inside prose, contradictory claimed codes or counts, fabricated claims beside the NOT STATED marker, wrong or conflicting years, wrong or decoy codes, missing facts and malformed claims fail their gates; decisive errors are hard failures without review
answer_oracle.review_policy: ambiguous or denied evidence (echo without an answer, hedged year/comparative sentences, negated or hedged code/count sentences, both years without an ordering claim, quoted year/code mentions, contradictory claimed codes or counts, fabricated claims beside the refusal marker, interrogative echo at item 3) sets review_required=true with the affected gate false; an inferred safe PASS never exists
answer_oracle.structure_modes: unique ascending 1-4 item markers (5 optional), 4-5 un-numbered lines, 4-6 comma/semicolon/pipe slots, else historical whole-answer containment semantics

outcome_semantics.completion: derived from verbatim finish_reason; when the runtime does not expose it, from completion_tokens >= lane-specific generation ceiling (DERIVED)

rung_dispositions.VALIDATED: all gates PASS with completion COMPLETE at required occupancy and depths
rung_dispositions.BUDGET_LIMITED: retrieval/synthesis evidence strong but answer truncated in the declared lane; keeps gate evidence visible; never VALIDATED and never FAILED-by-retrieval
rung_dispositions.FAILED: completed answer violates a frozen gate (a measured negative result)
rung_dispositions.USEFUL_CONTEXT_MAX_OPERATIONAL: highest rung passing all gates with a completed answer within a real declared operational cap for the chosen deployment profile
rung_dispositions.USEFUL_CONTEXT_MAX_SEMANTIC: claimable only from a PREDECLARED non-starving lane producing a completed, scorable answer; reasoning-trace facts never promote to semantic PASS

generalization_note: Family A is a controlled longitudinal retrieval/synthesis diagnostic only; it does not establish multi-document, codebase or conversation-context usefulness. Supplementary family evidence must be reported separately.

prospective_lanes.semantic_reserve: bounded calibrated total ceiling on a disjoint response-class calibration set
prospective_lanes.operational_reserve: declared deployment cap when real, measured independently; never use the historical 512 floor as a universal semantic limit
